API: Session(profile,cfg,parent_budget_bytes=None).begin(meta).feed(literal stored bytes)...end(); one active object per Session; Root caller chooses up to5 fixed profiles
literal_layers: Same V2 literal stored-member API, not outer transport/archive framing; plain/xz/gzip. Unknown compression fails closed; aux is opaque literal with compression literal/text only.
profile_binding: Optional meta.stream_completion_profile must equal newSourceID; selecting this new adapter itself selects V3. No automatic qualification registration.
completion_rules: Geometry maps exact CTA/warp to bounded linear uint32 mask slot. Physical last-warp mask derives from declared block threads.
Every record active mask must stay inside physical lanes and must not intersect already EXITed lanes, including re-EXIT.
EXIT contributes only its active mask. Union is monotonic; physical warp coverage is required when traceg warp closes.
All declared CTA/warp/inst counts, complete TB/newline/compressed CRC/EOF and whole literal SHA still required. Legacy raw interleaving uses same masks and whole-grid counts.
All physical lanes in every physical warp must EXIT by EOF; no last-root-only shortcut. Valid partial divergent EXITs may be followed by other live-lane work then later EXITs.

Zero mask is parsed/native-decoded as zero-active metadata, gives no exit credit and cannot revive lanes. Zero-active records after full exit remain allowed; no claim actual hardware scheduled/emitted such records.
supported_versions: Traceg0..4, optional lineinfo0/1; raw legacy0..2 with inline CTA/warp. Raw>=3 remains explicit rejected because inline ownership absent; no invented reconstruction.
not_granted: No existing125 corruption inferred from V2 counterexample.
No actual125 full-body Native readback/registration/public activation.
No GPU, original engine main, cycle/scheduler, scientific budget or hardware/timing/numerical qualification.
Resource limits are explicit resource/profile HOLDs, not declarations that ISA or hardware does not support a trace.
